snippet.title: Escape from the Black Monolith - Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam, coming soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4191860/Escape_from_the_Black_Monolith/

ESCAPE FROM THE BLACK MONOLITH is a short but tough fast-paced shooter that lets you GUN your way down a vertiginous SKYSCRAPER. Glide around the building, unlock weapons, and shoot down all of the monolith's evil guardians!

A light boomer shooter in the vein of QUAKE but the level is a shoot 'em up, with some rogue-lite elements. Choose which boss to fight to control your progression during your run!
